svg.title: Eligible submission runtimes for 10% error reads
svg.desc: Historical course report, page 7. The public runtime comparison covers ten submissions the author considered valid general-purpose implementations under the course rules. Eligibility is the author's assessment; the supplied report itself does not give an eligibility ranking. Runtime values digitized from a raster plot and rounded; close rankings are uncertain. 1M/b PS: approximately 0.19 minutes; 1M/b BS_WG: approximately 7.3 minutes; 1M/b DZ: approximately 10 minutes; 1M/b LO: approximately 14 minutes; 1M/b MC: approximately 17 minutes; 1M/b MD: approximately 15 minutes; 1M/b MJ_HG_SP: approximately 17 minutes; 1M/b AS_JD: approximately 21 minutes; 1M/b AG_SP_FS: approximately 39 minutes; 1M/b MS_ZB: approximately 14 minutes; 5M/b PS: approximately 0.29 minutes; 5M/b BS_WG: approximately 8.4 minutes; 5M/b DZ: approximately 13 minutes; 5M/b LO: approximately 14 minutes; 5M/b MC: approximately 20 minutes; 5M/b MD: approximately 16 minutes; 5M/b MJ_HG_SP: approximately 19 minutes; 5M/b AS_JD: approximately 18 minutes; 5M/b AG_SP_FS: approximately 40 minutes; 5M/b MS_ZB: approximately 13 minutes; 20M/b PS: approximately 0.54 minutes; 20M/b BS_WG: approximately 11 minutes; 20M/b DZ: approximately 26 minutes; 20M/b LO: approximately 22 minutes; 20M/b MC: approximately 34 minutes; 20M/b MD: approximately 15 minutes; 20M/b MJ_HG_SP: approximately 22 minutes; 20M/b AS_JD: approximately 68 minutes; 20M/b AG_SP_FS: approximately 49 minutes; 20M/b MS_ZB: approximately 30 minutes.
